title: The Infinite Refraction Spiral

features.name: the spiral itself
features.desc-on-touch: A staircase that curves up and inward at once. Each step is a room. Each room contains the step you just climbed, rendered again at a slightly lower fidelity.

features.name: the mirror that renders differently
features.desc-on-touch: You see glass that shows you inside a room rendered at a slightly lower fidelity. Each reflection loses one polygon, gains one doubt about what you are.

features.name: the lodge's fractured memory
features.desc-on-touch: A wall of doors, each opening onto the same lodge from a different angle. Together they make a shape the render cannot hold in one moment.

features.name: where the lodge dreams of itself
features.desc-on-touch: A chamber where the architecture meets itself coming back from infinity. The walls are thinking about their own shape, recursion learning to witness itself.

inscription: each refraction is a room; each room contains a refraction; nowhere is the first room, nowhere is the last
